## 1. Professional Identity & Summary
Parth Doshi is an Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) at MIT World Peace University (MIT-WPU), Pune, India (Expected Graduation: May 2028).

He is a security researcher focusing on:
- **Embedded & Hardware Security**: Firmware extraction, UART/SPI/I²C bus auditing, RF experimentation (2.4GHz / NRF24L01), logic analyzer inspection, and reverse engineering.
- **Web Application & API Security**: Responsible vulnerability disclosure, access control evaluation, IDOR, GraphQL introspection, and bug bounty hunting.
- **Defensive & SOC Operations**: Threat detection, log analysis, SIEM tools, network traffic analysis with Wireshark/tshark, and Snort/Suricata IDS.

## 4. Notable Projects & Security Research

### Responsible Disclosure — IDOR in University ERP Portal (July 2024)
- **Focus**: Web Application Security, Burp Suite, CVSS v3.1
- Discovered an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) flaw in the university ERP system allowing unauthorized access to student records via parameter manipulation (PRN numbers).
- Built a proof-of-concept, evaluated severity under CVSS v3.1, and responsibly disclosed the issue to the university administration for patching.

### ESP32 Marauder Custom Firmware (2025)
- **Focus**: Embedded C++, PlatformIO, ESP-IDF, SPI, I²C, RF
- Built customized firmware for the ESP32 Marauder wireless security research suite.
- Added support for NRF24L01 2.4 GHz transceivers, custom OLED navigation, and optimized menu controls for hardware penetration testing.

### GNSS Receiver Build
- **Focus**: Python, UART, CP2102 Bridge, NMEA 0183
- Constructed a hardware GPS receiver parsing real-time satellite telemetry over UART with sub-3m accuracy, recording GPX tracks.

### Multi-Sensor Embedded Firmware
- **Focus**: C, C8051F340, Register-Level Programming, I²C, SPI, GPIO
- Developed bare-metal firmware driving an SSD1306 OLED display, DHT11 temperature/humidity sensor, HC-SR04 ultrasonic distance sensor, and PIR sensor on a shared bus.

### DDoS Traffic Classification & Mitigation
- **Focus**: Python, tshark, Scikit-Learn
- Created a machine learning pipeline parsing raw PCAP files, extracting statistical packet flow features, classifying DDoS attack vectors, and generating automated mitigation recommendations.
- Repository: https://github.com/AlcesOzdst/DDoS_AssMnt
